description: A local, two-way Solidity editor: paste or create contracts, edit structured Blueprint nodes with typed ports, inspect exact source and export Solidity without losing unsupported constructs. Execute public functions in local sandboxes with typed inputs, trace replay and console output.

userStories.title: Create the source-preserving program model
acceptanceCriteria: Represent files, contracts, functions, symbols, typed expression ports, statement regions, source spans and execution/value relationships
Keep layout independent of program semantics and preserve opaque syntax
Preserve source bytes when no changes are made
userStories.notes: Rewrite acceptance; supersedes the completed repository-first PRD. Advanced syntax stays source-backed rather than being silently simplified. Verified by compiler, Foundry, browser and repository regression checks.

userStories.title: Compile and inspect imported Solidity

Show branch, loop, break, continue, return and explicit revert paths

Report missing imports and incompatible pragmas without fetching external dependencies

userStories.title: Execute functions in isolated local sandboxes
userStories.description: Execute functions in isolated local sandboxes
acceptanceCriteria: Compile deployment/runtime artifacts with ABI and source maps
Deploy from a funded local account and preserve state between runs
Support constructor arguments, callers, payable wei, arrays/tuples and decoded return/event/revert data
Bound execution gas, expire idle sessions and stop Anvil children on reset/shutdown
userStories.notes: Implemented local Anvil execution and recorded source-map playback. Verified by 64 unit/integration tests and 11 browser tests, including Coin mint/send/revert/reset, branches, repeated internal calls, constructors, payable calls, arrays, and gas exhaustion.
